_how_to_use: Each source is one page or feed the Monday sweep reads. Set "on": true to use it.
Only add sources whose terms allow automated reading, e.g. organisers' and venues' own websites,
their public calendar (.ics) feeds, or Eventbrite organisers through the official API.
Types: "page" (website that publishes schema.org Event data), "ics" (calendar feed),
"eventbrite_organizer" (needs the EVENTBRITE_TOKEN secret and the organiser's numeric id).
"city" is used when the source doesn't say; "cat" forces a category for every event from it.
